Using a thin-bladed screwdriver, pull out the stopper of the transmission control cable, turn the nut approximately 180° counterclockwise, and while holding the nut, disconnect the transmission control cable from the shift lever retainer.

item.ptxt: Do not turn the nut too far, as the internal spring will come off the nut and the transmission control cable cannot be reused.
Do not remove the stopper. If it has been removed, reinstall it in the same position.

s2.ptxt: While pushing the claw of the lock piece, hold down the claw on the back side and push up the lock piece from the back side.
Turn the nut of the transmission control cable 180° counterclockwise, and while holding the nut, push in the stopper until it clicks 2 time.
Install the cable outer of the transmission control cable to the shift lever retainer, check that the spring is at position A as shown in the illustration, and push in the stopper.

atten4.ptxt: If the stopper cannot be pushed in, turn the nut back slightly and push it in again.

s2.ptxt: Install the cable end to the shift control unit.

item.ptxt: Check that the lock piece protrudes.
Securely install the cable end all the way to the base of the pin.

s2.ptxt: Push the lock piece into the adjuster case to lock it.

atten3.ptxt: If it is not pushed in securely, the cable cannot be locked and shift operation will not be reliable.

s2.ptxt: After adjustment, inspect the operation, and if there is a problem, adjust again.
Install the instrument panel finish panel lower.

Inspection Using SST (TaSCAN)

s3.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the screen instructions, display the "ECU Data Monitor" - "Ignition Timing #1" screen and measure the ignition timing.

atten3.ptxt: Perform with A/C OFF, electric fan OFF, and in the N or P range.

s3.ptxt: Display the "Active Test" screen, select "Ignition Timing #1", and measure the ignition timing with "TC Terminal ON".
Check that the ignition timing advances quickly when the engine speed is increased.

s2.ptxt: Inspection using general instruments

s3.ptxt: Using SST (diagnosis check wire No.2), connect between terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of the DLC3.

item.ptxt: Never short the wrong terminals, as this will cause a malfunction.
Perform with A/C OFF, electric fan OFF, and in the N or P range.

s3.ptxt: Remove the cowl top outside front w/ front wiper motor & link. (see )
Remove the V-bank cover.
Connect the clip of the timing light to the wire harness for the coil connector of cylinder No.1.

atten3.ptxt: Use a timing light that can detect the primary signal.

s3.ptxt: Check that the ignition timing is within the standard.
Disconnect terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of the DLC3.
Check that the ignition timing is within the standard.
Check that the ignition timing advances quickly when the engine speed is increased.
Remove the timing light.
Install the V-bank cover.
Install the cowl top outside front w/ front wiper motor & link. (see )

s2.ptxt: Inspect the idle speed. (see )
After maintaining the engine speed at 2500r/min for 2 minutes, inspect the CO and HC concentration at idle.
Warm up and stop the engine; after 5 minutes, check that the oil level is between the L and F marks on the oil level gauge. If the oil level is low, check for leaks and add oil up to the F mark.
